title: OpenBaoCredentials
description: Credentials for an OpenBao (or HashiCorp Vault) KV v2 secrets engine.

address.title: Address
address.description: The OpenBao server address, e.g. https://openbao.internal:8200

mount.title: Mount
mount.description: Path of the KV v2 secrets engine mount

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Optional namespace, sent as the X-Vault-Namespace header. Leave empty for deployments without namespaces.

roleId.title: Role ID
roleId.description: AppRole role_id, used when authMethod is `approle`

secretId.title: Secret ID
secretId.description: AppRole secret_id, used when authMethod is `approle`

authPath.title: Auth Path
authPath.description: Mount path of the AppRole auth method

caCertPath.title: CA Certificate Path
caCertPath.description: Path to a PEM bundle trusted when verifying the OpenBao server certificate

skipTlsVerify.title: Skip TLS Verify
skipTlsVerify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification. Development only: it exposes credentials in transit.

connectTimeoutMs.title: Connect Timeout (ms)
connectTimeoutMs.description: Connection timeout for requests to OpenBao

readTimeoutMs.title: Read Timeout (ms)
readTimeoutMs.description: Read timeout for requests to OpenBao
